blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `exportOrdersWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow exports orders matching the specified filters. It's used to
export orders to a CSV file.

This workflow doesn't return the exported orders. Instead, it sends a notification to the admin
users that they can download the exported orders.

steps.name: notifyOnFailureStep
steps.description:
This step sends one or more notification when a workflow fails. This
step can be used in the beginning of a workflow so that, when the workflow fails,
the step's compensation function is triggered to send the notification.

steps.name: useRemoteQueryStep
steps.description:
This step fetches data across modules using the remote query.

Learn more in the [Remote Query documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query).

:::note

This step is deprecated. Use [useQueryGraphStep](/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep) instead.

:::

steps.name: sendNotificationsStep
steps.description: This step sends one or more notifications.

children.name: select
children.description:
The fields to select. These fields will be passed to
[Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query), so you can
pass order properties or any relation names, including custom links.

children.name: filter
children.description: The filters to select which orders to export.

children.name: $and
children.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "and" condition.

children.name: $or
children.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "or" condition.

children.name: id
children.description: The IDs to filter the orders by.

children.name: sales_channel_id
children.description: Filter orders by their associated sales channel's ID.

children.name: customer_id
children.description: Filter orders by their associated customer's ID.

children.name: region_id
children.description: Filter orders by their associated region's ID.

children.name: created_at
children.description: Filter the orders by their creation date.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: Filter orders by their update date.
